communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Recovery Policy RP9524.10
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

On June 15, 2010, FEMA published a notice of availability and request for comment on a proposed Recovery Policy, RP9524.10, Direct Disaster-Related Damage to Eligible Facilities, 75 Fed. Reg. 33,821 (June 15, 2010) (FR Doc. 2010-14291), Docket ID FEMA-2010-0024. The notice stated that the proposed policy was available at regulations.gov in that docket and that all comments received would be posted there without change. The docket is no longer retrievable at regulations.gov. The notice identified the Regulation & Policy Team, Office of Chief Counsel, Room 835, as the office receiving mailed comments and stated that submitted comments could be inspected there.

I request:

The proposed RP9524.10 policy as posted to Docket ID FEMA-2010-0024 for public comment, with any background document or fact sheet posted with it.
All public comments received in Docket ID FEMA-2010-0024, whether submitted through the Federal eRulemaking Portal or by mail.

Both items consist of documents that were publicly posted to, or publicly submitted for posting in, the docket, and should require no exemption review. The notice stated that FEMA would not prepare a response-to-comments document, so no such document is requested here.

I am an “other” requester for fee purposes and agree to pay fees up to $50; please contact me before incurring costs above that amount.

Sincerely, 
Richard Brady

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Richard Brady
